description.value:
Bow Save DC: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Dexterity modifier

Open Bow in the Toolbox

Features

Mastery (Slow)

If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

Coatings

This weapon can apply specialized coatings that you purchase or craft as inventory items. You can apply only coating types unlocked for this weapon's rarity (and any lower rarity). Once on each of your turns (no action required), you can expend one coating vial you are carrying and make that coating your active coating. An active coating has 3 charges. It remains active until its charges are expended, you activate a different coating (any remaining charges on the previous coating are lost), or you finish a Short or Long Rest (any remaining charges are lost). When you make a ranged attack with this bow while a coating is active, one charge is expended and the coating's effect applies as described for that coating. You still expend ammunition (arrows) as normal for the attack. Coatings do not regenerate; new vials must be bought or crafted.

Charging Sidestep

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you leap up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If you make a ranged attack with this bow later on the same turn, that attack deals an extra [[/r 1d4]] piercing damage on a hit.

Dragonpiercer

Action.

As an Action, you fire an arrow in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Bow Save DC. A creature takes [[/r 4d6]] piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

▸ Upgrade — True Dragonpiercer

Your Dragonpiercer damage becomes [[/r 6d6]]. The shot ignores half cover and three-quarters cover.

Tracer I

When you hit a creature with a ranged attack using this bow, you gain 1 Tracer (maximum 3). All Tracer fades if you haven't made an attack with this bow for 1 minute. When you use Dragonpiercer, you can spend any number of Tracer. The shot deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] piercing damage for each Tracer spent.

▸ Upgrade — Tracer II

Your Tracer maximum becomes 5.

▸ Upgrade — Tracer III

Your Tracer maximum becomes 7.

Advanced Coatings

You unlock Blast, Poison, Paralysis, and Sleep coatings.

Coatings

Power Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] piercing damage.

▸ Upgrade — Power Coating Upgrade I

Your Power Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 2d6]] piercing.

▸ Upgrade — Power Coating Upgrade II

Your Power Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 3d6]] piercing.

Close Range Coating

You do not have Disadvantage on this ranged attack from a hostile creature within 5 feet of you. This coating expends a charge when you make the attack, hit or miss.

Acid Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] acid damage.

▸ Upgrade — Acid Coating Upgrade I

Your Acid Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 2d6]] acid.

Cold Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] cold damage.

▸ Upgrade — Cold Coating Upgrade I

Your Cold Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 2d6]] cold.

Fire Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] fire damage.

▸ Upgrade — Fire Coating Upgrade I

Your Fire Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 2d6]] fire.

Lightning Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d6]] lightning damage.

▸ Upgrade — Lightning Coating Upgrade I

Your Lightning Coating's extra damage becomes [[/r 2d6]] lightning.

Blast Coating

On a hit, each other creature within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Bow Save DC or take [[/r 1d8]] fire damage.

Poison Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d4]] poison damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Bow Save DC or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on a success.

Paralysis Coating

On a hit, the attack deals an extra [[/r 1d4]] lightning damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Bow Save DC or have the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. If the target succeeds on this save, it is immune to your Paralysis Coating for 24 hours.

Sleep Coating

On a hit, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Bow Save DC or have the Unconscious condition for 1 minute, or until it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it awake. Constructs and Undead automatically succeed on the save.
